Q19_fixed_accepted_scope_check.previous_key_gap_repaired: The v14 omissions concerning bag-development Noise while waiting and a later Malfunction’s effect on an already-boarded Character are now explicit.

Q128_novelty_retained.actual_Q128_request: After successfully boarding an Escape Pod, may you launch immediately rather than wait? When it launches now or on a later turn, what happens to the Pod token and occupants’ miniatures, and do those occupants continue taking part in active play?
Q128_novelty_retained.closest_actual_Q19_request: What permits or prevents entering an Escape Pod, what must you resolve first, how many Characters and Heavy Objects fit, and what are the options and consequences when you wait?
Q128_novelty_retained.closest_Q19_key_clause: After boarding one may launch immediately or choose to wait.

primary_passage.source: English original manual printed/PDF p.26, extracted lines 2712-2716
primary_passage.text: If you launch immediately (or if you launch in one of the following turns) – remove the miniature of your Character and the Escape Pod token from the game. From now on, you do not take part in the game any longer.

Q128_novelty_retained.reason: The fixed Q19 scope requires launch as a waiting choice, but does not request physical token/miniature removal and cessation of active participation. Q128 directly requests those distinct launch outcomes. Its corrected p.26 citation is accurate.
